newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-KASHIMA BEATS MARINOS 3-0, LEADS J-LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KASHIMA BEATS MARINOS 3-0, LEADS J-LEAGUE.

text.p: Led by their Brazilian stars Mazinho and Bismarck, the defending J-League champion Kashima Antlers kept their place at the top of the table with a 3-0 away win against the Yokohama Marinos on Saturday night.
Mazinho put Kashima ahead one minute into the second half when he pounced on a poorly headed clearance by a Marinos defender in the penalty box and slammed home a goal from just 10 metres out.
Bismarck made it 2-0 in the 68th minute when he capitalised on disarray in the Marinos defence after a free kick for Kashima.
Yasuo Manaka added the third goal eight minutes before full time when Marinos goalkeeper Yoshikatsu Kawaguchi fumbled a shot.
The win took Kashima to 28 points from 12 matches as the J-League resumed after a month-long break.
They are one point ahead of Yokohama Flugels, who also won in a 4-0 goal romp over lowly Ichihara, who have only 10 points.
Brazilian imports were also responsible for the Flugels easy win with Sampaio and Valber each scoring.
Brazilian striker Edilson also scored twice just before the break to help Kashiwa notch a comfortable 3-1 win at Kawasaki and move up to third place four points behind the Antlers.
